messages:
Alex: Quick FYI — deploy tonight 22:00-23:00 UTC (rolling). v3.8 -> canary (10%), then grad to prod. No DB migrations. Expect brief instance restart spikes (~2-3m) per AZ. I'll be primary watcher. @Maria can you be backup? :raised_hands:

Maria: Yep, I can cover backup. I'll be available from 21:30 UTC. Any special smoke to run?

Alex: Thanks — quick smoke: auth flow, inference p99, API /health, DB connections (should be stable). I'll paste checklist below.

Jin: Clarify freeze window — does this block infra deploys or just app changes?

Alex: Freeze applies only to infra changes that affect k8s node pools or scaling groups. App-level rollouts are OK. If you're planning infra work, file here and we'll defer.

Lucy: Which feature flags control the new routing? I want toggle in case canary misbehaves.

Alex: Flag is `ff.route_v3`. To turn off quickly:

```bash
# disable routing at runtime
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  https://flags.redwood.internal/api/flags/ff.route_v3/disable
```

Alex: Rollback plan if needed:

```bash
kubectl -n inference rollout undo deployment/inference-api --to-revision=2
# watch
kubectl -n inference rollout status deployment/inference-api
```

Priya: Can we add a small traffic shadow to staging first? Want to sanity-check latency curve.

Alex: We can shadow 5% for 30m after canary. Will add watcher tag `shadow-staging` and note in console.

oncall-bot: Reminder: scheduled canary deploy starting at 22:00 UTC. Watchers: Alex, Maria. Escalation: eng-oncall -> eng-sre.

Maria: I'll monitor logs and traces. If p50 spikes > 200ms or error rate > 0.5% for 5m, I'll start rollback.

Jin: Thumbs up. I'll avoid pushing unrelated PRs during the window.

Alex: Thanks — checklist (short):
- confirm canary 10% at 22:00
- run smoke endpoints
- monitor p50/p95/p99 and error-rate
- verify ff.route_v3 toggle works
- shadow to staging 5% for 30m
- escalate to eng-sre if rollback needed

Lucy: Copy. I'll be on call for infra if anything unexpected pops.

Alex: Great. Ping here if you need to swap. I'll post a quick summary when canary is live. :rocket:
